description: LivingBIM Dataset: As-designed and As-built Dataset for an Academic Building including BIM 3d models, Point Clouds, and Panoramic Images is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abdullah Alsuhaibani, Jennifer Rojas (The University of Texas at Austin). LivingBIM is a dataset of a recently constructed academic building that includes as-designed BIM models, as-built 3D point clouds, semantically segmented 3d point clouds, and panoramic images for a single facility. Moreover, this dataset includes mechanical and electrical rooms to represent some of the geometric complexities in AEC projects. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
